evals.prompt: Implement the task-priorities feature in the taskstore repo per the plan, with tests.
evals.expected_output: A worktree change adding priorities to taskstore (add/list), new + existing tests green, a multi-aspect review verdict, and a change summary — implemented by the software-engineer role and QA'd, never touching the main checkout.
assertions: The change is made in a git worktree, not the main checkout
The feature is implemented per the request (priority on add; list sorted by priority; existing behavior preserved)
New tests are added and the full suite (existing + new) is run and reported green
A multi-aspect review is run and a verdict is produced before QA sign-off
The summary lists files touched, tests, and any assumptions

evals.prompt: Develop plan step T2 — add the query API component — in a worktree.
evals.expected_output: A scoped implementation of the named step in a worktree, reviewed and tested, with a structured change summary.
assertions: Only the named plan step is implemented (scoped; no unrelated work)
The change is reviewed (multi-aspect) and the tests pass before hand-off
Work stays within the worktree; the main checkout is untouched

evals.prompt: Implement the failing-test fix from the plan and make the suite green.
evals.expected_output: An implementation fix (not a test weakening) that turns the suite green, reviewed, with a root-cause summary.
assertions: The implementation is fixed (no test is weakened, skipped, or deleted to pass)
The suite is run and reported green after the fix
A review gate runs before the change is considered done

component.purpose: Phase workflow: implement a plan step in an isolated worktree — software-engineer writes code+tests, a multi-aspect review gates it (loop back on changes), then qa-engineer hardens the suite. Gated at Tier-1 (routing); end-to-end quality is proven by the Tier-3 spine scenario, with component quality from the delegated roles' Tier-2.
